metadata.description: Validation test for the Betaflight altitude estimate (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T21): alt_est is 0 until arming and then tracks the height above the arming point within 1.5 m while climbing at pDOP 1.5, at pDOP 6 from 10 s, on baro alone without a fix from 20 s, and with the fix back from 25 s; vario_est follows the climb rate.
